images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original photographic-style CubeMaster cleaning-guide anatomy illustration, square composition, NOT a real photograph. Reference image 1 is a historical Rubik's manufacturer's 2x2 assembly diagram captured in 2008; use it ONLY as factual mechanical reference, not as a page to reproduce. Make one new close-up workshop scene based specifically on the PENULTIMATE assembly view at the BOTTOM LEFT of the reference: the historical black-plastic Rubik's 2x2 is partly assembled, its LOWER layer intact and TWO REAR upper corners in place; the TWO FRONT upper corners are separated and placed just above their corresponding open positions in an exploded view. The complete cube has exactly EIGHT external corner pieces, each carrying THREE square colored facelets on mutually perpendicular surfaces; show SIX in the body plus TWO separated, never eight solid little cubes. Coloring and physical handedness from the source: RED on top, WHITE toward the camera, GREEN on the right; the separated upper front-right corner is red-top/white-front/green-right, and the upper front-left corner is red-top/white-front/blue-left. Preserve actual source geometry of the opened circular black tracks, retained internal support and the small black non-colored guide wedges visible in this source panel; do NOT substitute a six-arm 3x3 core, magnets, decorative gears, bolts, invented attachments, or random internals. Keep the hidden remainder hidden. The exposed opening must be clear and the two separated corners must obviously fit their locations. Subtle two fine BLUE dashed assembly alignment lines, no movement or levering instruction. Clear pale cool-blue silicone work mat on a bright white tabletop, the same clean practical workshop aesthetic as CubeMaster; grey folded microfiber cloth in a far corner, no other props. Crisp realistic molded black plastic with slight surface texture, vivid red/green/blue and neutral white, fine dark seam lines, soft daylight and gentle contact shadows. Main puzzle and separate parts comfortably occupy the central 75 percent of a square image, with at least 10 percent clear margin on all sides and bottom for a caption overlay. The image must prioritize true reference geometry over an attractive fantasy mechanism. No text, no logo, no watermark, no tools, no screwdriver, no oil, no hands, no water. This is a reference-specific anatomy/remounting illustration, NOT a universal removal method for current Rubik's 2x2 models.
